findings.problem: Recap pictogram tiles use 20px text (explicit fontSize 20px at lines 134 and 143) and the CA/T and 110111 tiles are tiny; below the 28px minimum label rule.
findings.fix: Enlarge the recap pictograms (fewer or larger tiles, zoom up) so tile letters and digits are at least 28px, or draw them as shapes without text.
findings.evidence: s10@6.75 and s10@8.9: bit tiles and letters in cards 1 and 3 read about 20px.

findings.problem: Many in-figure labels are under 28px: scene 4 chips (monkey, keeper, tries N, best N/28, letter bubbles), scene 5 and 6 chips (generation N, N of 20 on the star hill, 47%/32%), scene 7 tags, scene 8 chips and stepper (Score, Select...), scene 9 category labels (Planning, Design...) and the 'this lecture' tag in scene 2. Several visibly measure about 20-26px. common-2.js q.num is explicitly 24px.
findings.fix: Raise chips and labels to at least 28px (video.css line 71 sets 24px for one class); drop secondary chips where space is tight.

findings.problem: The first figure element sits against the headline with almost no gap: scene 4 target bar, scene 5 climber chip, scene 6 bar value numerals (9) and scene 7 mutate tag. They touch or nearly touch the headline's second line.
findings.fix: Move the figure down by about 16-24px or shrink the headline block so every scene keeps at least 12px of clear space.

findings.problem: Frames are not byte-identical when the same absolute time is rendered in a different order. s10@6.75 gave three different PNGs (about 850 pixels differ, all in the text of the boss-quiz button while it pops) and s8@3.25 about 40 pixels. The source is pure (no random, Date, timers, rAF, transition or animation), so this is Chrome re-rasterising scaled text, not an update() impurity. 58 other stills match in both orders or differ only by anti-aliasing noise.
findings.fix: Optional: avoid scaling text during the pop (scale the button background with a pseudo-element, or pop it with opacity and translate only).
findings.evidence: md5 of s10-6.75 across 4 runs, and pixel diff bbox (280,912)-(800,983).
